run_benchmark_torch_mm: run a benchmark for the torch.mm operator with 128x128 tensor inputs and collect metrics
create_bench_config_op: create a benchmark configuration for a named PyTorch operator like torch.mm
create_op_args_tensors: create operator input arguments from a list of tensor type definitions and keyword args
make_op_config_workload: make an OperatorConfig that initializes the operator workload and input data generators
run_op_executor_backward: run an OpExecutor with backward pass execution and collect benchmark result metrics
